usage: policy for any type of static security Scan by Severity
name: Static analyzer (SAST) alerts should not occur
description: SAST (Static Application Security Testing) issues in your code files should not be present.
detailedDescription: SAST (Static Application Security Testing) applications are the most basic type of security vulnerability detection applications that an organization should use. From SQL injections to cross-site scripting SAST applications are a basic requirement to stop easily preventable issues from making their way to production.
